_comment: The one feature matrix. scripts/features.py renders it into README.md, docs/explainer.html and site/public/features.html; CI fails if any of them differs from what it generates. Change a row here, run `python3 scripts/features.py`, commit all four files.

rows.label: One-call token source
rows.explainer_label: Request and refresh access tokens automatically
rows.sub: Discover, find the identity, mint, call the token endpoint, cache, force refresh

rows.label: DPoP-combined mode
rows.explainer_label: Use DPoP for client authentication (DPoP-combined mode)
rows.sub: In the one-call flow and the SPIFFE bootstrap

rows.label: DPoP-bound tokens at a resource
rows.explainer_label: Use DPoP to prove key possession when calling a service
rows.sub: Per-request proof with ath, nonce retry on use_dpop_nonce

rows.label: Fail-closed defaults
rows.explainer_label: Stop when required security checks fail (fail-closed defaults)
rows.sub: Required challenge, explicit evidence paths, https only

rows.label: Name the operator on the one-call class
rows.explainer_label: Name the responsible person or organisation when requesting access

rows.label: Drop the token-endpoint challenge
rows.explainer_label: Omit the token-request challenge where the identity service allows it
rows.sub: For attesters that accept a challenge only once

rows.label: Logging hooks
rows.explainer_label: Record SDK events without logging credentials
rows.sub: Off by default, one event vocabulary, never a credential (docs/logging.md)

rows.label: Attester profiles
rows.explainer_label: Configure the connection to an attestation issuer (attester profiles)
rows.sub: PingFederate by default, static endpoints, or your own (docs/attester-profiles.md)

rows.label: Trace every call as curl
rows.explainer_label: Show requests as curl commands for troubleshooting
rows.sub: Credentials redacted unless you turn it off

rows.label: Asserted context at mint
rows.explainer_label: Send extra context for the attestation issuer to check
rows.sub: An unverified discriminator for an attester-side resolver

rows.label: Client Attestation builder
rows.explainer_label: Create a Client Attestation

rows.label: PoP JWT and DPoP proof builders
rows.explainer_label: Create proof-of-possession JWTs and DPoP proofs

rows.label: ES, RS and PS keys at 256, 384 and 512
rows.explainer_label: Choose the digital signature algorithm

rows.label: operator claim on the builder
rows.explainer_label: Include the responsible person or organisation in a Client Attestation

rows.label: workload and authorization_details claims
rows.explainer_label: Include application details and requested permissions in a Client Attestation

rows.label: External signer
rows.explainer_label: Sign with a key held in OpenBao or HashiCorp Vault

rows.label: Evidence auto-detect
rows.explainer_label: Find available platform identity evidence automatically
rows.sub: Environment token, token file, SPIRE socket, GCP metadata

rows.label: Azure IMDS evidence
rows.explainer_label: Use identity evidence from Microsoft Azure

rows.label: AWS web-identity evidence
rows.explainer_label: Use web-identity evidence from AWS

rows.label: SPIFFE issuance bootstrap
rows.explainer_label: Obtain a Client Attestation using SPIFFE platform identity

rows.label: Token validator
rows.explainer_label: Check incoming access tokens
rows.sub: Signature, typ, issuer, expiry, audience, scope, introspection

rows.label: MCP and A2A protected-resource helper
rows.explainer_label: Add access checks to Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) services

rows.label: Authorization-server metadata discovery
rows.explainer_label: Find the Authorization Server configuration automatically

rows.label: Challenge handling
rows.explainer_label: Handle requests for further authentication or human approval
rows.sub: Parse a policy point's challenge, then resolve it with a CIBA push or a web consent link
